blocks.text: Tags are mutable pointers; digests are immutable content hashes. `latest` is only the default tag name, not "the newest" image.

items: Non-reproducible: the same Dockerfile builds something different next month.
Silently stale: if `redis:latest` is cached, `docker run redis` doesn't check the registry, so two hosts can run different "latest".

blocks.code: FROM python:3.12-slim-bookworm@sha256:<digest>   # tag documents, digest resolves

items: Pin the index digest for multi-arch tags; a per-platform manifest digest locks you to one architecture.
Digest pins freeze CVEs unless Renovate/Dependabot proposes updates.
Your own images: push an immutable tag per build (git SHA) and deploy by it or its digest.

blocks.text: Q: "Why not deploy :latest?" A: "It's a mutable pointer and hosts may run different cached versions of it, so deploys aren't reproducible or auditable and there's no rollback target. Deploy an immutable tag or a digest, and keep pins fresh with automated update PRs."

items: Tag = mutable name; digest = immutable content.
latest is a convention, and local caches make it stale.
Pin by digest plus automated updates.
Deploy by git-SHA tag or digest.
